parts: Last week, an Ethereum researcher asked crypto holders to start planning for something he called bunker mode.
His worry: that A.I. could find a shortcut through the maths that protects every wallet.
No such attack has been shown.
But the question it raises is exactly the right one.

a.label: Ready for adversaries that don't exist yet

parts: What would it take to build a blockchain that is ready for adversaries that don't exist yet?
If attackers have A.I., defenders need it too.
That's why Nishq is being designed to be natively guarded by Omnix's own intelligence, A.L.K.I.
The aim is an autonomous guardian that watches the network around the clock,
searches its own code for weaknesses before anyone else can,
spots unusual patterns the moment they begin,
and helps the community respond, openly and on-chain.
